title.en: An Act Establishing An Agro-fishery High School in Barangay Kipit, Municipality of Labason, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte, to Be Known as the Kipit Agro-fishery High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Nông-thủy sản Kipit tại Barangay Kipit, Đô thị Labason, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Norte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเกษตร-ประมง Kipit ในบารังไกย์ Kipit เทศบาล Labason จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Norte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Agro-Perikanan Kipit di Barangay Kipit, Kotamadya Labason, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Norte, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established an agro-fishery high school in Barangay Kipit, Municipality of Labason, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, to be known as the Kipit Agro-Fishery High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
